product_overview: The product adds an "Actividad" tab to the student record in Odoo for Faculty users. It lets them review a chronological history of campus content and evaluation events and export that history as CSV.
core_goals: Open a student record and review the student's activity history
View campus content and evaluation events in a read-only activity table
Export the student's activity history to CSV

features.name: Student Activity tab
features.description: A faculty-only activity tab on the student form that displays recent campus content and evaluation events in a read-only table and allows CSV export.
user_flows: Navigate to /web/login -> Enter valid credentials -> Submit the login form -> Open the Students list -> Open the student "Alumno E2E Activity" -> Open the "Actividad" tab -> Review the activity table with columns Fecha, Tipo, Curso / canal, Elemento, Detalle, Resultado, and Lote -> See a row containing "Contenido E2E"

Navigate to /web/login -> Enter valid credentials -> Submit the login form -> Open the Students list -> Open the student "Alumno E2E Activity" -> Open the "Actividad" tab -> Export the activity history as CSV -> See the CSV file download start

routes.description: Student list and form in the Odoo backend web client

features.name: Student Activity tab
features.description: Faculty-only "Actividad" tab on the op.student form showing campus content and evaluation events, with CSV export
user_interactions: Open the student "Alumno E2E Activity" from the Students list
See read-only table with columns Fecha, Tipo, Curso / canal, Elemento, Detalle, Resultado, Lote
See a row with content "Contenido E2E"
Click the "Exportar CSV" button to download the CSV

known_limitations.issue: Tab and export button restricted to group openeducat_core.group_op_faculty; server also enforces with AccessError
known_limitations.impact: Non-faculty users do not see the tab
